build a CropSquareAndResize preprocessor to crop a square region from an image and resize to 84x84 pixels
build an AddObservation preprocessor to inject a custom callable-generated observation into each timestep
test the CastPreprocessor to verify dtype casting works correctly for float32 and float64 arrays
test the DowncastFloatPreprocessor to verify it downcasts higher precision floats to lower precision types
test the RenameObservations preprocessor to verify observation keys are renamed correctly with error handling
test the MergeObservations preprocessor to verify concatenating multiple observations into a single merged observation
test the CropImageObservation preprocessor to verify cropping image observations with relative width height and offset parameters
create a ThresholdReward preprocessor that returns sparse reward hi or lo based on a threshold value
build an L2Reward preprocessor that computes continuous reward from the L2 distance between two observation keypoints
create a ThresholdedL2Reward preprocessor that gives sparse reward when two keypoints are within a threshold distance
build a CombineRewards preprocessor that steps multiple reward preprocessors in sequence and combines them with a strategy
create a StagedWithSuccessThreshold strategy that stages sequential task rewards and gives normalized reward for solved tasks
create a ThresholdReward preprocessor that outputs hi when reward is at or above a threshold and lo otherwise
create an L2Reward preprocessor that computes negative L2 distance between two observations scaled and offset
create a ThresholdedL2Reward preprocessor that gives a fixed reward when L2 distance between two observations is below a threshold
create a ComputeReward preprocessor that applies a custom lambda function to observations to compute a scalar reward
create a FilterReward preprocessor with a ConsecutiveValueFilter that only passes rewards after N consecutive identical values
create a FilterReward preprocessor with a StackedRewardsFilter that rewards when the last K rewards are all above a threshold
create a CombineRewards preprocessor that combines multiple reward preprocessors using max, min, sum, or a custom strategy
create a StagedWithActiveThreshold combination strategy that rewards proportionally to the number of sub-rewards above a threshold
create a StagedWithSuccessThreshold combination strategy that focuses reward on the first unsolved stage below a threshold
create a PreprocessorTimestep from a dm_env TimeStep with optional pterm and result values
convert a PreprocessorTimestep back to a standard dm_env TimeStep for environment compatibility

compose a CompositeTimestepPreprocessor to chain multiple preprocessors in order for sequential timestep transformation

test the ValidationFrequency enum modes ALWAYS, NEVER, ONCE, and ONCE_PER_EPISODE for spec validation

test the as_list method for tree traversal of nested CompositeTimestepPreprocessor instances
